description: Siticone NetFrameworkUI is a modern UI library for .NET Framework 4.8 and above. Build fast, sleek, and high-performance WinForms desktop apps with hardware-accelerated, pixel-perfect controls—seamlessly integrated for a polished, modern experience.
releaseNotes:
Siticone UI Controls - Key Improvements and New Controls

IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ BEFORE UPDATING

• Securely back up your existing projects before updating.
• Read the changelog below carefully before updating your library version.
• Contact Siticone support before updating if you have questions or need clarification.
• Test the new version in a separate test project before applying it to a production project.

BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY

All updated controls remain backward compatible with existing projects.

The improved SiticoneBarChart preserves its existing data-binding properties, public methods, events and core behavior. Existing projects using DataSource, LabelMember, ValueMember, BarClick, BarHover and related APIs should continue to work without requiring code changes.

The new SiticoneStackedBarChart is an additional control and does not replace or modify the existing SiticoneBarChart.

IMPROVED CONTROL: SiticoneBarChart

The SiticoneBarChart has received major visual, performance, data-binding and interaction improvements.

Improvements include:

• Correct value-based bar sizing so each bar accurately reflects its assigned value.
• Improved vertical and horizontal chart rendering.
• Support for positive, negative and mixed values.
• Improved automatic minimum and maximum value scaling.
• Optional user-defined minimum and maximum axis values.
• Optional modern nice-number axis scaling.
• Adaptive tooltips that automatically switch to the left, right, above or below when close to the control boundaries.
• Tooltips are kept fully visible inside the chart control.
• Customizable tooltip placement, spacing, padding and corner radius.
• Customizable tooltip content through the ToolTipOpening event.
• Modern rounded bars with optional gradient rendering.
• Improved light and dark chart themes.
• Smooth time-based loading animations.
• Configurable animation duration, stagger and easing.
• Smooth hover highlighting and bar lift effects.
• Single-bar selection support.
• Keyboard navigation and accessibility improvements.
• Improved category labels, value labels, grid lines, axis lines and zero-line rendering.
• Configurable value-label positions, including Outside, InsideEnd and Center.
• Improved hit testing based on the visible animated bar area.
• Optional chart title and modern empty-data display.
• Efficient BeginUpdate and EndUpdate methods for grouped updates.
• SetDataSource method for performing a single efficient data-binding operation.
• Support for DataTable, BindingSource, IListSource, IEnumerable and strongly typed collections.
• Data-binding error handling through the DataBindingError event.
• Image rendering and export through RenderToBitmap and SaveImage.
• Improved Visual Studio designer and smart-tag integration.
• Properties and events are organized under clearly identified Siticone BarChart categories.

ENHANCED SiticoneBarChart EVENTS

Chart events now provide useful information to handlers, including:

• Bar index
• Label
• Numeric value
• Original bound data item
• Current animated bounds
• Final bar bounds
• Normalized value
• Selection state
• Chart orientation
• Mouse location and mouse event information

Available events include:

• BarClick
• BarDoubleClick
• BarHover
• BarMouseEnter
• BarMouseLeave
• BarMouseMove
• SelectedBarChanged
• DataBound
• DataBindingError
• ToolTipOpening
• AnimationCompleted

NEW CONTROL: SiticoneStackedBarChart

This release introduces the new SiticoneStackedBarChart control for displaying multiple related values within each category.

Main features include:

• Standard stacked bar charts.
• 100% percentage-based stacked bar charts.
• Vertical and horizontal orientations.
• Multiple configurable data series.
• Support for positive, negative and mixed series values.
• Strongly typed collection and DataTable binding.
• Modern rounded stacked segments.
• Optional gradient segment rendering.
• Smooth staggered loading animations.
• Animated hover and selection states.
• Adaptive tooltips that remain inside the chart boundaries.
• Interactive and customizable chart legends.
• Optional segment value labels.
• Optional percentage labels.
• Optional category total labels.
• Configurable value, percentage and total number formats.
• Automatic and manually configurable axis scaling.
• Keyboard navigation and accessibility support.
• Segment, category, selection, legend, binding and animation events.
• Original bound data items are supplied through interaction events.
• Bitmap rendering and image export support.
• Visual Studio designer and smart-tag support.
• Properties and events are organized under clearly identified Siticone StackedBarChart categories.
• C# 7.3-compatible public API and implementation.

SITICONE BARCHART USAGE EXAMPLE

public sealed class MonthlyRevenue
{
public string Month { get; set; }
public double Revenue { get; set; }
}

var chartData = new List<MonthlyRevenue>
{
new MonthlyRevenue { Month = "January", Revenue = 1200 },
new MonthlyRevenue { Month = "February", Revenue = 1800 },
new MonthlyRevenue { Month = "March", Revenue = 1550 },
new MonthlyRevenue { Month = "April", Revenue = 2100 }
};

siticoneBarChart1.SetDataSource(
chartData,
nameof(MonthlyRevenue.Month),
nameof(MonthlyRevenue.Revenue));

siticoneBarChart1.Title = "Monthly revenue";
siticoneBarChart1.EnableTooltips = true;
siticoneBarChart1.EnableAnimations = true;

SITICONE STACKED BARCHART USAGE EXAMPLE

{

public double Desktop { get; set; }
public double Web { get; set; }
public double Mobile { get; set; }
}

var salesData = new List<MonthlyPlatformSales>
{
new MonthlyPlatformSales
{
Month = "January",
Desktop = 1200,
Web = 700,
Mobile = 450
},
new MonthlyPlatformSales
{
Month = "February",
Desktop = 1800,
Web = 900,
Mobile = 650
},
new MonthlyPlatformSales
{
Month = "March",
Desktop = 1550,
Web = 1100,
Mobile = 800
}
};

siticoneStackedBarChart1.SetDataSource(
salesData,
nameof(MonthlyPlatformSales.Month),

```
new SiticoneStackedBarChart.StackedBarSeries
{
    Name = "Desktop",
    ValueMember = nameof(MonthlyPlatformSales.Desktop)
},

new SiticoneStackedBarChart.StackedBarSeries
{
    Name = "Web",
    ValueMember = nameof(MonthlyPlatformSales.Web)
},

new SiticoneStackedBarChart.StackedBarSeries
{
    Name = "Mobile",
    ValueMember = nameof(MonthlyPlatformSales.Mobile)
});
```

siticoneStackedBarChart1.Title = "Monthly platform sales";
siticoneStackedBarChart1.ShowLegend = true;
siticoneStackedBarChart1.ShowValueLabels = true;
siticoneStackedBarChart1.ShowTotalLabels = true;

UPDATE RECOMMENDATION

Although the improved SiticoneBarChart remains backward compatible, visual output may appear more accurate because bar dimensions, scaling, labels and tooltip positioning have been corrected and refined.

Review charts that use manually configured axis limits, custom themes or tightly constrained control sizes after updating.

Always test the updated package in a separate project before deploying it to an existing production application.
